verdict.rationale: The pack contains no documented scenario versioning, change review, or rollback capability. 'Scenario history' (make-docs-18) is a bare page title that never mentions versions or restoring a prior version, so it may refer to execution logs. Cloning a scenario is a manual workaround, and API URL-path versioning concerns the API itself, not users' automations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
